name: BRAND TEXT
description: Hifine is a comprehensive trading company specializing in the import and export of all kinds of products. Employing over 40 highly skilled personnel, our annual revenues are now worth in excess of USD30,000,000. With two large offices and ten business departments, we have a strong capability for filling orders from various customers in markets worldwide.Having rich experience in the handling of garments, luggage and cases, hardware and tools, auto parts, and other light industrial products, we can offer highly competitive prices for all series. Established in 1999, we have been commended as a "Star Unit" by Chinese governmental agencies for our outstanding business record.Regarding credibility as being of first priority when conducting all operations, professional quality, punctual shipping of orders, and superior sourcing services ensure our excellent reputation. Offering flexible trade terms, we have built up a fast-response product supply network among domestic producers.In addition to import and export, we also offer a variety of other services for our clients. These include acting as an agent for their company in China, manufacturing with supplied materials, and counter trade according to clients' requirements. Currently exporting to customers in North America, Western Europe, Japan, Africa and East Asia, we are now improving our internal management systems in order to further enhance our competitiveness.Welcoming interested companies to cooperate with us, we look forward to having the opportunity of working with companies around the world for joint growth and mutual success.
